bounded_host_request.command:
set -o pipefail
printf 'C01_BEGIN\n'
printf 'DISPATCHER_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
root=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
test -d "$root/.git" || git -C "$root" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null || exit 11
printf 'CORE_HEAD='; git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'CORE_BRANCH='; git -C "$root" branch --show-current
printf 'CORE_STATUS='; test -z "$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain)" && echo CLEAN || echo DIRTY
printf 'SOURCE_SHA256='; sha256sum "$root/runtime/model_gate.py" | cut -d ' ' -f1
printf 'RUNTIME_SHA256='; docker exec ai-core-model-gate sha256sum /app/runtime/model_gate.py | cut -d ' ' -f1
for port in 18181 18182 18183 18184; do
  code="$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import sys,urllib.request; u="http://127.0.0.1:"+sys.argv[1]+"/health"; print(urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=5).status)' "$port" 2>/dev/null)" || code=ERROR
  printf 'HEALTH_%s=%s\n' "$port" "$code"
done
printf 'C01_END\n'
